panel files.not_taken: The panel did not take the file: it has what it had before, and nothing was changed. One panel did that when it had no room left.
panel files.too_fine: This look has more detail than fits in the room Libre Panel uses on this panel, and it is not written coarser: choose another look.
panel files.no_room: Not written: with the standby clip that is on the panel (685 KB), the boot logo would be more than Libre Panel puts on this panel. Write the standby clip again first: it becomes smaller.
panel files.cut_off: The standby clip did not fit: the panel took {took} of {size} bytes. It was taken off again, so that the panel is not left full: the panel has no standby clip now. Dark is the smallest look.
